startUrls.title: Property or activity URLs
startUrls.description: Traveloka hotel, Xperience activity, bus, airport-transfer or car-rental page URLs. The product family is detected from the URL path, so you can mix them freely.

objectIds.title: Object IDs
objectIds.description: Bare numeric Traveloka object IDs. These use the Product type setting below, since there is no URL to infer it from.

productType.title: Product type
productType.description: Which Traveloka product the IDs belong to. Only used for bare Object IDs and for URLs whose path cannot be classified.

maxReviewsPerObject.title: Max reviews per object
maxReviewsPerObject.description: How many reviews to download for each property or activity. Reviews arrive in pages, so this is also the stopping point for pagination.

sortBy.title: Sort order
sortBy.description: Order Traveloka returns reviews in. Newest first is best for monitoring; lowest rating first is best for a complaint audit.

ratingFilter.title: Rating filter
ratingFilter.description: Keep only reviews in a rating band. Traveloka exposes bands, not exact score cut-offs.

formatFilter.title: Format filter
formatFilter.description: Keep only reviews that have text, media, or both. Useful when you need photos, or when you want to drop score-only ratings before running NLP.

ratingTagIds.title: Aspect tag filter
ratingTagIds.description: Keep only reviews carrying these aspect tags, for example GOOD_STAFF_FRIENDLINESS or BAD_CLEANLINESS. Run once without this to see which tags an object has, listed in the summary record under ratingTags.

includeSummaryRecord.title: Include a summary record per object
includeSummaryRecord.description: Emit one OBJECT_SUMMARY row per property or activity holding the overall rating, total review count and aspect tags, alongside the individual reviews.
includeSummaryRecord.groupDescription: The dataset mixes one summary row per object with one row per review; filter on recordType.

includeRatingTags.title: Include aspect sentiment tags
includeRatingTags.description: Collect the aspect tag aggregate (cleanliness, staff, location and so on) with counts, split into positive and negative tag IDs.

pageSize.title: Reviews per request
pageSize.description: How many reviews to ask for per API call. Twenty matches what Traveloka's own web client asks for.

locale.title: Locale
locale.description: Traveloka locale. This affects the language of aspect tag labels and rating labels, and which translation of a review text you receive.

currency.title: Currency
currency.description: Currency context for the session. Reviews carry no prices, so this rarely matters.

requestDelaySeconds.title: Delay between requests
requestDelaySeconds.description: Seconds to pause between API calls. Raise it if you see repeated 429 or 5xx responses on large pulls.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy
proxyConfiguration.description: Proxy settings. Residential is the default: Traveloka's AWS WAF answers a captcha to the session bootstrap on most Apify datacenter IPs. If you pick a datacenter group, the actor tries it first and falls back to residential sessions when it is challenged.
